subject: Maths

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600">
  <title>Pythagoas' theorem</title>
  
  <style>
    .title-text { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 26px; font-weight: bold; fill: #2c3e50; text-anchor: middle; }
    .subtitle-text { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; fill: #7f8c8d; text-anchor: middle; }
    .label-text { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; fill: #34495e; text-anchor: middle; }
    .formula-text { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: bold; fill: #e74c3c; text-anchor: middle; }
    .side-label { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; fill: #2c3e50; text-anchor: middle; }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="600" fill="#fcfcfc" />

  <!-- FIXED LAYOUT: Header Band (y between 20 and 70, nothing else here) -->
  <text x="400" y="45" class="title-text">Pythagoras' Theorem</text>
  <text x="400" y="68" class="subtitle-text">In a right-angled triangle, a² + b² = c²</text>

  <!-- FIXED LAYOUT: Square on vertical side a (left) -->
  <polygon points="320,290 320,380 230,380 230,290" fill="#3498db" stroke="#2980b9" stroke-width="2">
    <animate attributeName="fill-opacity" values="0.1; 0.8; 0.8; 0.8; 0.8; 0.8; 0.8; 0.8; 0.1; 0.1" keyTimes="0; 0.22; 0.44; 0.66; 0.88; 0.89; 0.9; 0.95; 0.99; 1" dur="9s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    <animate attributeName="stroke-width" values="2; 2; 2; 2; 2; 5; 2; 5; 2; 2" keyTimes="0; 0.22; 0.44; 0.66; 0.67; 0.73; 0.79; 0.85; 0.89; 1" dur="9s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </polygon>

  <!-- FIXED LAYOUT: Square on horizontal side b (below) -->
  <polygon points="320,380 440,380 440,500 320,500" fill="#2ecc71" stroke="#27ae60" stroke-width="2">
    <animate attributeName="fill-opacity" values="0.1; 0.1; 0.8; 0.8; 0.8; 0.8; 0.8; 0.8; 0.1; 0.1" keyTimes="0; 0.22; 0.44; 0.66; 0.88; 0.89; 0.9; 0.95; 0.99; 1" dur="9s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    <animate attributeName="stroke-width" values="2; 2; 2; 2; 2; 5; 2; 5; 2; 2" keyTimes="0; 0.22; 0.44; 0.66; 0.67; 0.73; 0.79; 0.85; 0.89; 1" dur="9s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </polygon>

  <!-- FIXED LAYOUT: Square on hypotenuse c (up and right) -->
  <polygon points="320,290 440,380 530,260 410,170" fill="#9b59b6" stroke="#8e44ad" stroke-width="2">
    <animate attributeName="fill-opacity" values="0.1; 0.1; 0.1; 0.8; 0.8; 0.8; 0.8; 0.8; 0.1; 0.1" keyTimes="0; 0.22; 0.44; 0.66; 0.88; 0.89; 0.9; 0.95; 0.99; 1" dur="9s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    <animate attributeName="stroke-width" values="2; 2; 2; 2; 2; 5; 2; 5; 2; 2" keyTimes="0; 0.22; 0.44; 0.66; 0.67; 0.73; 0.79; 0.85; 0.89; 1" dur="9s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </polygon>

  <!-- FIXED LAYOUT: Triangle -->
  <polygon points="320,290 320,380 440,380" fill="#ecf0f1" stroke="#34495e" stroke-width="3" />

  <!-- FIXED LAYOUT: Right-angle marker -->
  <polygon points="320,380 340,380 340,360 320,360" fill="none" stroke="#34495e" stroke-width="2" />

  <!-- FIXED LAYOUT: Side & Component Labels -->
  <text x="275" y="340" class="side-label">a</text>
  <text x="380" y="445" class="side-label">b</text>
  <text x="425" y="275" class="side-label">Hypotenuse c</text>

  <!-- ANIMATED LABELS (Fading in per step) -->
  <!-- 0s - 2s: Square a area -->
  <text x="275" y="330" class="label-text" fill-opacity="0">
    a² = 9 units
    <animate attributeName="fill-opacity" values="0; 1; 1; 1; 0" keyTimes="0; 0.22; 0.66; 0.89; 1" dur="9s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </text>

  <!-- 2s - 4s: Square b area -->
  <text x="380" y="480" class="label-text" fill-opacity="0">
    b² = 16 units
    <animate attributeName="fill-opacity" values="0; 0; 1; 1; 0" keyTimes="0; 0.44; 0.66; 0.89; 1" dur="9s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </text>

  <!-- 4s - 6s: Square c area -->
  <text x="470" y="230" class="label-text" fill-opacity="0">
    c² = 25 units
    <animate attributeName="fill-opacity" values="0; 0; 0; 1; 0" keyTimes="0; 0.66; 0.67; 0.89; 1" dur="9s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </text>

  <!-- FIXED LAYOUT: Bottom 80 units reserved for formula caption -->
  <text x="400" y="560" class="formula-text" fill-opacity="0">
    a² + b² = c² (9 + 16 = 25)
    <animate attributeName="fill-opacity" values="0; 0; 0; 0; 1; 0" keyTimes="0; 0.66; 0.67; 0.89; 0.9; 1" dur="9s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </text>

</svg>

name: Parts of a circle
subject: Maths
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600">
  <title>Parts of a Circle</title>
  
  <!-- Styles for animations and typography -->
  <style>
    .bg { fill: #f8fafc; }
    .card { fill: #ffffff; stroke: #e2e8f0; stroke-width: 2; rx: 12px; }
    .title-text { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; fill: #1e293b; }
    .body-text { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; fill: #475569; }
    .label-bold { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; }
    
    .circle-base { fill: #f1f5f9; stroke: #3b82f6; stroke-width: 4; }
    .centre-point { fill: #ef4444; }
    
    .line-radius { stroke: #10b981; stroke-width: 4; stroke-linecap: round; }
    .line-diameter { stroke: #8b5cf6; stroke-width: 4; stroke-linecap: round; }
    
    /* Circumference drawing animation */
    @keyframes draw-circ {
      0% { stroke-dashoffset: 942; }
      50% { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
      100% { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
    }
    .circ-path {
      fill: none;
      stroke: #f59e0b;
      stroke-width: 5;
      stroke-dasharray: 942;
      animation: draw-circ 6s infinite ease-in-out;
    }

    /* Pulse animation for centre */
    @keyframes pulse {
      0% { r: 6px; opacity: 1; }
      50% { r: 10px; opacity: 0.6; }
      100% { r: 6px; opacity: 1; }
    }
    .pulse-centre {
      animation: pulse 2s infinite ease-in-out;
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="600" class="bg" />

  <!-- Header Card -->
  <rect x="40" y="20" width="720" height="70" class="card" />
  <text x="70" y="62" class="title-text">GCSE Mathematics: Parts of a Circle</text>

  <!-- Main Visual Area (Left) -->
  <rect x="40" y="110" width="460" height="460" class="card" />

  <!-- Main Circle Graphics Group centered at (270, 340) -->
  <g transform="translate(270, 340)">
    <!-- Base Circle fill -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="150" class="circle-base" />

    <!-- Diameter Line (Purple) -->
    <line x1="-150" y1="0" x2="150" y2="0" class="line-diameter" />
    
    <!-- Radius Line (Green) rotating slightly to show dynamism -->
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="106" y2="-106" class="line-radius">
      <animateTransform 
        attributeName="transform" 
        type="rotate" 
        values="0; 360" 
        dur="12s" 
        repeatCount="indefinite" 
        additive="sum" />
    </line>

    <!-- Animated Circumference highlight -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="150" class="circ-path" />

    <!-- Centre Point -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="6" class="centre-point" />
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="6" class="centre-point pulse-centre" />
  </g>


  <!-- Information Panel Area (Right) -->
  <rect x="520" y="110" width="240" height="460" class="card" />
  
  <text x="540" y="145" class="label-bold" fill="#1e293b">Key Definitions:</text>

  <!-- Legend Item 1: Centre -->
  <circle cx="555" cy="185" r="6" class="centre-point" />
  <text x="575" y="191" class="label-bold" fill="#ef4444">Centre</text>
  <text x="540" y="215" class="body-text">The exact middle point</text>
  <text x="540" y="235" class="body-text">of the circle.</text>

  <!-- Legend Item 2: Radius -->
  <line x1="540" y1="275" x2="570" y2="275" class="line-radius" />
  <text x="575" y="281" class="label-bold" fill="#10b981">Radius</text>
  <text x="540" y="305" class="body-text">Distance from centre</text>
  <text x="540" y="325" class="body-text">to any point on edge.</text>

  <!-- Legend Item 3: Diameter -->
  <line x1="540" y1="365" x2="570" y2="365" class="line-diameter" />
  <text x="575" y="371" class="label-bold" fill="#8b5cf6">Diameter</text>
  <text x="540" y="395" class="body-text">Across the circle,</text>
  <text x="540" y="415" class="body-text">through the centre.</text>
  <text x="540" y="435" class="body-text" font-size="14" font-style="italic" fill="#64748b">(Diameter = 2 × Radius)</text>

  <!-- Legend Item 4: Circumference -->
  <path d="M 540 475 Q 555 465, 570 475" fill="none" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" />
  <text x="575" y="481" class="label-bold" fill="#d97706">Circumference</text>
  <text x="540" y="505" class="body-text">The total distance</text>
  <text x="540" y="525" class="body-text">all the way around.</text>

</svg>

name: Series circuit
subject: Physics
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600">
  <title>Series Circuit</title>
  
  <style>
    .title { font-family: sans-serif; font-weight: bold; font-size: 24px; fill: #1e293b; text-anchor: middle; }
    .subtitle { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 16px; fill: #475569; text-anchor: middle; }
    .label { font-family: sans-serif; font-weight: bold; font-size: 16px; fill: #0f172a; }
    .caption { font-family: sans-serif; font-weight: bold; font-size: 16px; fill: #334155; text-anchor: middle; }
    .wire { fill: none; stroke: #334155; stroke-width: 4; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
    .component { fill: #f8fafc; stroke: #334155; stroke-width: 3; rx: 6; ry: 6; }
    .current-dot { fill: #2563eb; r: 6; }
  </style>

  <!-- Title & Subtitle Band (y: 20 to 70) -->
  <text x="400" y="35" class="title">Series Circuit</text>
  <text x="400" y="60" class="subtitle">One single loop: current is the same everywhere, voltage of the cell is shared</text>

  <!-- Circuit Diagram Background Panel -->
  <rect x="40" y="90" width="720" height="410" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="2" />

  <!-- Connecting Wires (Absolute Coordinates) -->
  <path d="M 120 280 L 120 180 L 300 180" class="wire" />
  <path d="M 400 180 L 680 180 L 680 280" class="wire" />
  <path d="M 680 320 L 680 420 L 500 420" class="wire" />
  <path d="M 400 420 L 120 420 L 120 320" class="wire" />

  <!-- Components -->
  <!-- Cell (Left) -->
  <rect x="80" y="280" width="80" height="40" class="component" />
  <line x1="100" y1="288" x2="100" y2="312" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="4" />
  <line x1="112" y1="280" x2="112" y2="320" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="4" />
  <line x1="124" y1="288" x2="124" y2="312" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="4" />
  <line x1="136" y1="280" x2="136" y2="320" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="4" />
  <text x="120" y="350" class="label" text-anchor="middle">Cell</text>

  <!-- Lamp 1 (Top) -->
  <rect x="300" y="150" width="100" height="60" class="component" />
  <circle cx="350" cy="180" r="18" fill="none" stroke="#eab308" stroke-width="3" />
  <line x1="337" y1="167" x2="363" y2="193" stroke="#eab308" stroke-width="3" />
  <line x1="363" y1="167" x2="337" y2="193" stroke="#eab308" stroke-width="3" />
  <text x="350" y="135" class="label" text-anchor="middle">Lamp 1</text>

  <!-- Lamp 2 (Bottom) -->
  <rect x="400" y="390" width="100" height="60" class="component" />
  <circle cx="450" cy="420" r="18" fill="none" stroke="#eab308" stroke-width="3" />
  <line x1="437" y1="407" x2="463" y2="433" stroke="#eab308" stroke-width="3" />
  <line x1="463" y1="407" x2="437" y2="433" stroke="#eab308" stroke-width="3" />
  <text x="450" y="475" class="label" text-anchor="middle">Lamp 2</text>

  <!-- Extra descriptive text labels fulfilling requirements -->
  <text x="680" y="250" class="label" text-anchor="middle">Current</text>
  <text x="680" y="375" class="label" text-anchor="middle">Loop</text>

  <!-- Animated Current Dots (Clockwise flow around the loop) -->
  <circle class="current-dot">
    <animateMotion path="M 120 300 L 120 180 L 300 180 L 400 180 L 680 180 L 680 280 L 680 320 L 680 420 L 500 420 L 400 420 L 120 420 L 120 320 Z" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </circle>

  <circle class="current-dot" fill="#1d4ed8">
    <animateMotion path="M 120 300 L 120 180 L 300 180 L 400 180 L 680 180 L 680 280 L 680 320 L 680 420 L 500 420 L 400 420 L 120 420 L 120 320 Z" dur="6s" begin="-2s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </circle>

  <circle class="current-dot" fill="#3b82f6">
    <animateMotion path="M 120 300 L 120 180 L 300 180 L 400 180 L 680 180 L 680 280 L 680 320 L 680 420 L 500 420 L 400 420 L 120 420 L 120 320 Z" dur="6s" begin="-4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </circle>

  <!-- Bottom 80 units reserved for formula caption -->
  <rect x="0" y="520" width="800" height="80" fill="#f1f5f9" />
  <text x="400" y="565" class="caption">Total Voltage = Voltage across Lamp 1 + Voltage across Lamp 2</text>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600">
  <title>Photosynthesis GCSE Biology Diagram</title>

  <defs>
    <!-- Background Gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="skyGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#EBF8FF"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#F7FAFC"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Leaf Gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="leafGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#48BB78"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#22543D"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Sun Glow Gradient -->
    <radialGradient id="sunGlow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FEFCBF" stop-opacity="1"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#F6E05E" stop-opacity="0.6"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ECC94B" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>

    <!-- Drop Shadow -->
    <filter id="shadow" x="-10%" y="-10%" width="120%" height="120%">
      <feDropShadow dx="2" dy="4" stdDeviation="4" flood-color="#000" flood-opacity="0.1"/>
    </filter>

    <!-- Photon Symbol -->
    <g id="photon">
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="10" fill="#ECC94B" opacity="0.9"/>
      <path d="M-15,0 L15,0 M0,-15 L0,15" stroke="#D69E2E" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>

    <!-- CO2 Molecule Graphic -->
    <g id="co2-molecule">
      <circle cx="-12" cy="0" r="8" fill="#CBD5E0"/>
      <text x="-12" y="5" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#2D3748" text-anchor="middle">O</text>
      <circle cx="12" cy="0" r="8" fill="#CBD5E0"/>
      <text x="12" y="5" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#2D3748" text-anchor="middle">O</text>
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="10" fill="#E53E3E"/>
      <text x="0" y="4" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFF" text-anchor="middle">C</text>
    </g>

    <!-- H2O Molecule Graphic -->
    <g id="h2o-molecule">
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="10" fill="#E53E3E"/>
      <text x="0" y="4" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFF" text-anchor="middle">O</text>
      <circle cx="-10" cy="10" r="7" fill="#CBD5E0"/>
      <text x="-10" y="13" font-size="9" font-weight="bold" fill="#2D3748" text-anchor="middle">H</text>
      <circle cx="10" cy="10" r="7" fill="#CBD5E0"/>
      <text x="10" y="13" font-size="9" font-weight="bold" fill="#2D3748" text-anchor="middle">H</text>
    </g>

    <!-- O2 Molecule Graphic -->
    <g id="o2-molecule">
      <circle cx="-10" cy="0" r="9" fill="#E53E3E"/>
      <text x="-10" y="4" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFF" text-anchor="middle">O</text>
      <circle cx="10" cy="0" r="9" fill="#E53E3E"/>
      <text x="10" y="4" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFF" text-anchor="middle">O</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Glucose Molecule Graphic -->
    <g id="glucose-molecule">
      <rect x="-25" y="-12" width="50" height="24" rx="6" fill="#D69E2E" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
      <text x="0" y="4" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFF" text-anchor="middle">Glucose</text>
    </g>
  </defs>

  <!-- CSS Animations -->
  <style>
    .pulse {
      animation: pulseGlow 3s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
      transform-origin: 150px 100px;
    }
    @keyframes pulseGlow {
      0% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.8; }
      100% { transform: scale(1.08); opacity: 1; }
    }

    .rotate-sun {
      animation: spin 20s linear infinite;
      transform-origin: 150px 100px;
    }
    @keyframes spin {
      0% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
      100% { transform: rotate(360deg); }
    }

    .leaf-breeze {
      animation: breeze 4s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
      transform-origin: 400px 320px;
    }
    @keyframes breeze {
      0% { transform: rotate(0deg) translateY(0); }
      100% { transform: rotate(1.5deg) translateY(-3px); }
    }

    .bubble {
      animation: floatUp 3s ease-in infinite;
    }
    @keyframes floatUp {
      0% { transform: translateY(0px) scale(0.6); opacity: 0; }
      50% { opacity: 1; }
      100% { transform: translateY(-70px) scale(1.2); opacity: 0; }
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="600" fill="url(#skyGrad)" />

  <!-- Ground -->
  <path d="M0,480 Q400,460 800,480 L800,600 L0,600 Z" fill="#C6F6D5"/>
  <path d="M0,500 Q400,485 800,500 L800,600 L0,600 Z" fill="#9AE6B4" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- TITLE -->
  <text x="400" y="45" font-size="26" font-weight="bold" fill="#2D3748" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif">Photosynthesis in Plants</text>

  <!-- SUN AND LIGHT ENERGY -->
  <g class="rotate-sun">
    <circle cx="150" cy="100" r="70" fill="url(#sunGlow)" />
  </g>
  <circle class="pulse" cx="150" cy="100" r="35" fill="#ECC94B" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
  <text x="150" y="105" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#744210" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif">Light</text>

  <!-- Light Rays / Photons Moving -->
  <g>
    <use href="#photon" x="0" y="0">
      <animateMotion path="M 175 125 L 340 260" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </use>
    <use href="#photon" x="0" y="0">
      <animateMotion path="M 190 145 L 360 280" dur="2.5s" begin="0.7s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </use>
    <use href="#photon" x="0" y="0">
      <animateMotion path="M 150 140 L 320 290" dur="2.2s" begin="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </use>
  </g>
  <text x="235" y="195" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#D69E2E" font-family="sans-serif" transform="rotate(38, 235, 195)">Light Energy</text>

  <!-- CENTRAL LEAF -->
  <g class="leaf-breeze" filter="url(#shadow)">
    <!-- Leaf Body -->
    <path d="M400,180 C480,220 530,340 400,460 C270,340 320,220 400,180 Z" fill="url(#leafGrad)"/>
    <!-- Leaf Veins -->
    <path d="M400,180 L400,460" stroke="#9AE6B4" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.6"/>
    <path d="M400,240 L450,210" stroke="#9AE6B4" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" opacity="0.6"/>
    <path d="M400,280 L350,250" stroke="#9AE6B4" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" opacity="0.6"/>
    <path d="M400,320 L460,290" stroke="#9AE6B4" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" opacity="0.6"/>
    <path d="M400,360 L340,330" stroke="#9AE6B4" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" opacity="0.6"/>
    <path d="M400,400 L440,380" stroke="#9AE6B4" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" opacity="0.6"/>

    <!-- Chlorophyll Indicator Badge -->
    <circle cx="400" cy="310" r="28" fill="#2F855A" stroke="#9AE6B4" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="400" y="306" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFF" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif">Contains</text>
    <text x="400" y="322" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#F6E05E" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif">Chlorophyll</text>
  </g>


  <!-- INCOMING: CARBON DIOXIDE -->
  <g>
    <!-- Label -->
    <rect x="60" y="210" width="160" height="36" rx="8" fill="#FFF" stroke="#CBD5E0" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
    <text x="140" y="233" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#2D3748" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif">Carbon Dioxide</text>
    
    <!-- Path Arrow -->
    <path d="M225,228 L330,280" stroke="#A0AEC0" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="6,6" fill="none"/>
    <polygon points="330,280 318,276 322,286" fill="#A0AEC0"/>

    <!-- Animated Molecules -->
    <use href="#co2-molecule">
      <animateMotion path="M 230 228 L 335 280" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </use>
    <use href="#co2-molecule">
      <animateMotion path="M 230 228 L 335 280" dur="3s" begin="1.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </use>
  </g>


  <!-- INCOMING: WATER -->

  <!-- OUTGOING: OXYGEN -->

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600">
  <title>States of Matter - GCSE Chemistry</title>

  <style>
    .bg { fill: #f8fafc; }
    .card { fill: #ffffff; stroke: #e2e8f0; stroke-width: 2; rx: 12; }
    .title { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: bold; fill: #1e293b; text-anchor: middle; }
    .state-title { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; fill: #334155; text-anchor: middle; }
    .label { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; fill: #475569; text-anchor: middle; }
    .particle-solid { fill: #3b82f6; stroke: #1d4ed8; stroke-width: 2; }
    .particle-liquid { fill: #10b981; stroke: #047857; stroke-width: 2; opacity: 0.85; }
    .particle-gas { fill: #f59e0b; stroke: #b45309; stroke-width: 2; opacity: 0.85; }
    .main-title { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 28px; font-weight: bold; fill: #0f172a; text-anchor: middle; }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect class="bg" width="800" height="600" />

  <!-- Main Header -->
  <text x="400" y="45" class="main-title">States of Matter (GCSE Chemistry)</text>

  <!-- ==================== SOLID CONTAINER ==================== -->
  <g transform="translate(40, 70)">
    <rect class="card" width="220" height="420" />
    <text x="110" y="35" class="state-title">Solid</text>
    
    <!-- Chamber -->
    <rect x="20" y="60" width="180" height="260" fill="#eff6ff" rx="6" stroke="#bfdbfe" />

    <!-- Particles (Vibrating in fixed positions) -->
    <!-- Row 1 -->
    <circle cx="55" cy="95" r="14" class="particle-solid">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0; 2,-2; -2,1; 1,-2; 0,0" dur="0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
    <circle cx="95" cy="95" r="14" class="particle-solid">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0; -1,-2; 2,2; -2,-1; 0,0" dur="0.35s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
    <circle cx="135" cy="95" r="14" class="particle-solid">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0; 1,2; -2,-2; 2,1; 0,0" dur="0.45s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
    <circle cx="175" cy="95" r="14" class="particle-solid">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0; -2,1; 1,-1; -1,2; 0,0" dur="0.38s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>

    <!-- Row 2 -->
    <circle cx="55" cy="135" r="14" class="particle-solid">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0; -1,2; 2,-1; -2,-2; 0,0" dur="0.42s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
    <circle cx="95" cy="135" r="14" class="particle-solid">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0; 2,2; -1,-2; 1,1; 0,0" dur="0.36s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
    <circle cx="135" cy="135" r="14" class="particle-solid">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0; -2,-1; 2,2; -1,-1; 0,0" dur="0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
    <circle cx="175" cy="135" r="14" class="particle-solid">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0; 1,-2; -2,2; 2,0; 0,0" dur="0.39s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>

    <!-- Row 3 -->
    <circle cx="55" cy="175" r="14" class="particle-solid">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0; 2,1; -1,-2; -2,1; 0,0" dur="0.37s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
    <circle cx="95" cy="175" r="14" class="particle-solid">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0; -2,2; 1,-1; 2,-2; 0,0" dur="0.44s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
    <circle cx="135" cy="175" r="14" class="particle-solid">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0; 1,-1; -2,2; 1,2; 0,0" dur="0.35s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
    <circle cx="175" cy="175" r="14" class="particle-solid">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0; -1,-2; 2,1; -1,2; 0,0" dur="0.41s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>

    <!-- Row 4 -->
    <circle cx="55" cy="215" r="14" class="particle-solid">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0; 1,2; -1,-2; 2,0; 0,0" dur="0.39s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
    <circle cx="95" cy="215" r="14" class="particle-solid">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0; -2,1; 2,-1; -1,-1; 0,0" dur="0.42s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
    <circle cx="135" cy="215" r="14" class="particle-solid">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0; 2,-2; -1,2; 1,1; 0,0" dur="0.38s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
    <circle cx="175" cy="215" r="14" class="particle-solid">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0; -1,1; 2,2; -2,-2; 0,0" dur="0.36s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>

    <!-- Row 5 -->
    <circle cx="55" cy="255" r="14" class="particle-solid">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0; 2,-1; -2,-1; 1,2; 0,0" dur="0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
    <circle cx="95" cy="255" r="14" class="particle-solid">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0; -1,2; 1,-2; -2,1; 0,0" dur="0.37s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
    <circle cx="135" cy="255" r="14" class="particle-solid">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0; 1,1; -2,-2; 2,1; 0,0" dur="0.43s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
    <circle cx="175" cy="255" r="14" class="particle-solid">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0; -2,-2; 2,1; -1,-1; 0,0" dur="0.38s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>

    <!-- Explanatory Text inside container -->
    <text x="110" y="348" class="label">Close together &</text>
    <text x="110" y="370" class="label" font-weight="bold" fill="#1d4ed8">vibrate in place</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ==================== LIQUID CONTAINER ==================== -->
  <g transform="translate(290, 70)">
    <rect class="card" width="220" height="420" />
    <text x="110" y="35" class="state-title">Liquid</text>
    
    <!-- Chamber (Liquid sits at bottom half, but particles flow throughout) -->
    <rect x="20" y="60" width="180" height="260" fill="#ecfdf5" rx="6" stroke="#a7f3d0" />

    <!-- Particles (Flowing/moving past each other) -->
    <g>
      <!-- Fluid Particle 1 -->
      <circle cx="60" cy="100" r="14" class="particle-liquid">
        <animateMotion path="M0,0 Q 30,20 10,50 Q -10,80 20,110 Q 40,70 10,40 Z" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
      </circle>
      <!-- Fluid Particle 2 -->
      <circle cx="140" cy="90" r="14" class="particle-liquid">
        <animateMotion path="M0,0 Q -25,30 -40,10 Q -20,-10 0,20 Q 30,50 10,80 Z" dur="3.5s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
      </circle>
      <!-- Fluid Particle 3 -->
      <circle cx="100" cy="140" r="14" class="particle-liquid">
        <animateMotion path="M0,0 Q 20,-30 40,0 Q 20,40 -20,20 Q -40,0 -10,-30 Z" dur="4.5s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
      </circle>
      <!-- Fluid Particle 4 -->
      <circle cx="70" cy="200" r="14" class="particle-liquid">
        <animateMotion path="M0,0 Q -30,-20 -10,-60 Q 20,-40 30,-10 Q 10,20 0,0 Z" dur="3.8s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
      </circle>
      <!-- Fluid Particle 5 -->
      <circle cx="150" cy="220" r="14" class="particle-liquid">
        <animateMotion path="M0,0 Q 10,-40 -20,-50 Q -40,-20 -20,10 Q 0,30 0,0 Z" dur="4.2s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
      </circle>
      <!-- Fluid Particle 6 -->
      <circle cx="110" cy="270" r="14" class="particle-liquid">
        <animateMotion path="M0,0 Q -20,-10 -40,-40 Q -10,-30 20,-20 Q 10,10 0,0 Z" dur="3.6s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
      </circle>
      <!-- Fluid Particle 7 -->
      <circle cx="50" cy="270" r="14" class="particle-liquid">
        <animateMotion path="M0,0 Q 30,-30 50,-10 Q 20,20 -10,10 Q 20,-20 0,0 Z" dur="4.1s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
      </circle>
      <!-- Fluid Particle 8 -->
      <circle cx="160" cy="150" r="14" class="particle-liquid">
        <animateMotion path="M0,0 Q -30,20 -50,-10 Q -20,-40 10,-20 Q 30,0 0,0 Z" dur="3.9s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
      </circle>
    </g>

    <!-- Explanatory Text inside container -->
    <text x="110" y="348" class="label">Close, but can</text>
    <text x="110" y="370" class="label" font-weight="bold" fill="#047857">move past each other</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ==================== GAS CONTAINER ==================== -->
  <g transform="translate(540, 70)">
    <rect class="card" width="220" height="420" />
    <text x="110" y="35" class="state-title">Gas</text>
    
    <!-- Chamber -->
    <rect x="20" y="60" width="180" height="260" fill="#fffbeb" rx="6" stroke="#fde68a" />

    <!-- Particles (Far apart, fast, random motion) -->
    <g>
      <!-- Gas Particle 1 -->
      <circle cx="60" cy="100" r="14" class="particle-gas">
        <animateMotion path="M0,0 c 80,40 -40,120 60,180 c 50,-40 20,-140 -60,-180 z" dur="2.2s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
      </circle>
      <!-- Gas Particle 2 -->
      <circle cx="160" cy="120" r="14" class="particle-gas">
        <animateMotion path="M0,0 c -70,80 -100,-20 -120,90 c 30,60 110,-40 120,-90 z" dur="1.8s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
      </circle>
      <!-- Gas Particle 3 -->
      <circle cx="100" cy="240" r="14" class="particle-gas">
        <animateMotion path="M0,0 c 40,-100 80,50 -20,-80 c -60,40 -20,120 20,80 z" dur="2.0s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
      </circle>
      <!-- Gas Particle 4 -->
      <circle cx="150" cy="260" r="14" class="particle-gas">
        <animateMotion path="M0,0 c -90,-60 -30,-150 -100,-110 c -50,40 50,110 100,110 z" dur="2.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
      </circle>
      <!-- Gas Particle 5 -->
      <circle cx="70" cy="180" r="14" class="particle-gas">
        <animateMotion path="M0,0 c 60,-50 100,80 30,130 c -80,-30 -10,-100 -30,-130 z" dur="1.9s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
      </circle>
    </g>

    <!-- Explanatory Text inside container -->
    <text x="110" y="348" class="label">Far apart &</text>
    <text x="110" y="370" class="label" font-weight="bold" fill="#b45309">move very fast</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Footer Tip / GCSE Note -->
  <text x="400" y="535" class="label" font-size="14" fill="#64748b">
    Note: Changes of state involve heating and cooling, transferring energy to or from the particles.
  </text>
</svg>
